statement: AMD launched the Instinct MI400 Series family including MI455X for large-scale AI training and inference, plus MI430X for HPC and sovereign AI
why: A shipping second source for training-class accelerators widens the pool of parts buyers can actually get, which is the main relief valve when the incumbent is allocation-constrained.

impact.mechanism: A new training-class accelerator family from the second merchant vendor adds non-incumbent supply into a constrained market and gives buyers an alternative allocation channel.

evidence.excerpt: AMD Instinct MI400 Series GPU family, including MI455X
MI430X, the most advanced accelerator for HPC and sovereign AI workloads.

confidence.basis: Product launch stated in AMD's own results release; no volume or availability figure is given, so no quantity is asserted.
